changes.new_value: Implemented and verified 2026-10-20. rebuild_code_index now hashes via a short-lived handle, scans/extracts with no handle, then reopens to apply. apply_base_write wraps upsert + stale delete + DELETE resolved_edges in BEGIN IMMEDIATE; with_write_tx is the sole write path with commit-failure rollback and autocommit assertions. mark_refresh_started brackets every rebuild entry point; REBUILD_GUARD single-flights probe+rebuild with a post-acquire staleness re-check; metadata scans moved outside the handle; no-op rebuild skips edge rewrite (missing resolved edges are repaired); load_code_graph falls back to the filesystem snapshot on transient failures. Deviations: the guard is process-wide (one project per process), and the CLI fails fast with the holder/remedy instead of a 30s jittered wait. Gates: wm-code-intel 78+14, wm-core lib 230, watcher 13, e2e_code_intel 7, process-lock 1, wm-cli 5, mcp_test 116, graph_code_edges 5, clippy -D warnings, rustfmt. AC checkmarks still cannot be persisted (running MCP binary predates the check_ac fix).
